about: Every project command, by key. Run one with `uv run <key> [extra args]`; extra args go to the last command. `uv run commands` lists them. Agents use these keys instead of raw commands. Each key is also listed under [project.scripts] in pyproject.toml (tests/unit/test_commands.py keeps the two in sync).

commands.description: List every command with its description.

setup.description: First-time setup: install all deps (incl. dev tools) and turn on the git hooks in .githooks/ (skipped, with a note, when the folder is not a git repository).
run: if git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1; then git config core.hooksPath .githooks; else echo 'setup: not a git repository, so the git hooks in .githooks/ are not turned on'; fi

check.description: Every check, in order. Run before saying a task is done.

precommit.description: Fast checks the git pre-commit hook runs on every commit.

fmt.description: Format all Python files and apply safe lint fixes.

fmt-check.description: Fail if any Python file is not formatted.

lint.description: Lint with ruff (incl. no print() in src/, pathlib, async and security rules).

imports.description: Check the code-map boundaries (layers, SQL only in store, Gemini SDK only in llm).

tests.description: All offline tests (unit + contract). Live API tests are skipped.

tests-live.description: Tests that call the real Gemini API (needs GEMINI_API_KEY; costs money). Loads .env if present, like serve-dev.

secrets.description: Scan every tracked and new file for things that look like secrets.

secrets-staged.description: Scan only staged files for secrets (used by precommit).

serve-dev.description: Run the service on the dev corpus (CORPUS_DIR=data/corpus, PORT=8080 unless already set). Loads .env if present (Langfuse keys, Gemini key); ./serve itself never reads it.

questions-tune.description: Show tune-set questions with gold answers (the only way agents read dev questions): uv run questions-tune [--id pub_XXXX] [--set smoke] [--brief].

eval-retrieval.description: Retrieval-only eval of one chunking variant on the tune set (doc recall@5/10/20 both pooled over all gold documents and per question (q_recall, the headline: hybrid q_recall@10), all-gold@10, MRR for bm25/dense/hybrid; no answer LLM): uv run eval-retrieval --chunking recursive|fixed|whole [--max-tokens N] [--overlap N] [--no-header] [--fields] [--no-promote] [--bm25-only] [--screen] [--probe N], or uv run eval-retrieval --production (the index start-up builds in .cache/index). --fields puts field values the profile picks into every chunk header (variant name -fields; embeds every chunk again; not with --no-header or --production, whose index follows CHUNK_HEADER_FIELDS). Fusion flags [--bm25-weight W] [--dense-weight W] [--rrf-k K] change only the query step: the cached index is reused and the run name gets a suffix (-w<bm25>x<dense>, -k<k>). Report in eval/results/tune/retrieval/, one row in eval/history.csv. Loads .env if present (Gemini key; costs money, capped by the spend ledger).
run: set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; exec python -m eval.retrieval --set tune

eval-smoke.description: Smoke eval (10 questions, inside the tune set) against the running server (start it with `uv run serve-dev`): one POST /ask per question; the returned document_ids are scored as sets against the expected ids (precision, recall, F1, hit, all_gold, exact; unanswerable = no ids returned); then the answer judge (eval/judge.py) judges each answer text fact by fact (aggregates in the summary and history row, per question in judge.jsonl; --no-judge to skip it, it costs money). Report in eval/results/smoke/ask/<time>/ (summary.md, summary.json, per_question.jsonl, judge.jsonl), one row in eval/history.csv. Options: --concurrency N (1-4, default 2), --timeout S (default 180), --milestone <name>, --no-judge. Loads .env if present (Langfuse keys for the eval_ask trace, the Gemini key for the judge).
run: set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; exec python -m eval.run --set smoke --system full --url http://localhost:8080

eval-tune.description: Tune-set eval (30 questions; smoke is inside it) against the running server; same scores, options and report as eval-smoke, in eval/results/tune/ask/<time>/. Loads .env if present.
run: set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; exec python -m eval.run --set tune --system full --url http://localhost:8080

eval-heldout.description: Held-out test set (49 questions) against the running server. Only at a milestone the user names: --milestone <name> is required. Never tune on it. Everything goes to eval/results/heldout/ask/<time>/ (agents never read it); the printed lines and the history row hold aggregates only. The answer judge runs too (--no-judge to skip it) and reports aggregates only: nothing per question is written or traced. Loads .env if present.
run: set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; exec python -m eval.run --set heldout --system full --url http://localhost:8080

eval-all.description: Whole golden set (all 79 dev questions: tune + held-out) against the running server: the final test shown to graders, never used for tuning. Only at a milestone the user names: --milestone <name> is required. Readable summary (aggregates only) in eval/results/all/ask/<time>/; per-question results in eval/results/heldout/ask/<time>/ (agents never read them). The answer judge reports aggregates only (--no-judge to skip it). Loads .env if present.
run: set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; exec python -m eval.run --set all --system full --url http://localhost:8080

eval-judge-calibrate.description: Calibrate the answer judge (eval/judge.py, JUDGE_MODEL in config.py) against the hand checks of the 5 hand-checked tune runs: re-judges each run's per_question.jsonl answers and compares with its answer_check.json (fact status and verdict agreement, confusion matrices, Cohen's kappa, every disagreement, the judge's own consistency, cost; bar: JUDGE_CALIBRATION_BAR fact agreement). Tune data only; never calls /ask. Report in eval/results/judge-calibration/<time>/ (report.md, report.json). Options: --runs <folder> ..., --concurrency N, --no-cache, --label TEXT. Judgments are cached by prompt version in .cache/judge/. Loads .env if present (Gemini key; costs money, capped by .cache/spend/judge.json).

eval-baseline.description: One-shot RAG baseline on the same set (pass --set <name>). Not built yet: the runner exits with a message.
